_about: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) terminology for the Apple apps (every zh-Hant.lproj table) and the Android app (values-zh-rTW). One entry per concept: the term each platform uses, the variants it must not use, and the evidence the choice rests on. Read by scripts/check_zh_hant_terms.py, which fails on any forbidden variant in a string VALUE. The allowlist names a (file, key, phrase) where a forbidden sequence is legitimately part of a different word, with the reason; an entry whose phrase is gone fails, so it can only shrink. Changing a term means changing it here, with new evidence, in the same pull request as the catalogues. Counts were measured 2026-09-26: macOS = the 5,549 .loctable files under /System and /Applications/Safari.app that carry a zh_TW table (365,533 strings; a count is the number of strings containing the term); Android = platforms/android-36/data/res/values-zh-rTW/strings.xml from the SDK.

concepts.english: session (a running CLI conversation; also a browser session cookie)
concepts.evidence: macOS zh_TW: 會話 0, 作業階段 11 (「若要繼續，請關閉作用中的作業階段。」), 工作階段 2 (「等待遠端工作階段」). Android framework zh-rTW: 工作階段 2 (「讀取安裝工作階段」), 會話 0. Microsoft and Google (Chrome) zh-TW say 工作階段. 工作階段 is the one term Apple, Android, Microsoft and Google all use, and the Android catalogue already said it 9 times. 作業階段 is forbidden as well: it is also correct Taiwanese, which is exactly how a catalogue ends up split between two words. History: #557 unified the Apple catalogue on 會話 (114 strings); replaced here.

macOS zh_TW: 警示 34, 警報 44, 告警 0. Android framework zh-rTW: 警示 4, 告警 0. 告警 is the mainland word, and zh-Hans keeps it. History: #582 moved Android zh-rTW to 告警 while #593 moved Apple zh-Hant to 警示; both now say 警示.

concepts.english: account (the CLI Pulse account, and a provider account)
concepts.evidence: macOS zh_TW: 帳號 5,469, 帳戶 0 (Apple's own product is 「Apple帳號」). Android framework zh-rTW: 帳戶 43, 帳號 0, so on Android 帳號 is a product decision rather than the platform's word: one name for the CLI Pulse account in both phone apps. The Tauri desktop keeps Microsoft's 帳戶 and is not scanned here. A vendor's own product name keeps its 帳戶 (Google 帳戶, GCP 服務帳戶): see the allowlist.

macOS zh_TW: 程序 383 strings, 4 of them 處理程序, all four Apple Intelligence intent summaries (「（處理程序：${processInstanceIdentifier}）」). Android framework zh-rTW writes 處理程序 (StrictMode 「處理程序 %1$s 已違反…」, the kill-background-processes permission) and also bare 程序 (the ANR and heap-dump dialogs); Windows says 處理程序. So Apple forbids 處理程序 and Android keeps it, and Android forbids nothing here because 處理程序 contains 程序.

concepts.english: provider (an AI service such as Claude or Codex)
concepts.evidence: No platform has a word for an AI service. macOS zh_TW: 服務商 0, 供應商 133 (Home's electricity 「供應商」, 「網際網路服務供應商」), 提供者 110 (News 「新聞提供者」), 提供商 1. Android framework zh-rTW: 供應商 15 (「無線服務供應商」), 提供者 5 (「位置提供者」), 服務商 0. 服務商 is the short form of 服務供應商 (macOS 34) and what the Apple catalogue already said 77 times; Android's four 提供者 (the Providers screen, its empty state and two PDF headings) were changed to match.
macOS zh_TW: 設定 10,756 (the Settings app is 「設定」), 設置 57 (the mainland spelling, left in a few old AirPort and Maps strings). Android framework zh-rTW: 設定 159, 設置 0.

allowlist.reason: Google's own zh-TW name for its account is 「Google 帳戶」, and the user is being told which Google sign-in to use, so the string names it the way Google's sign-in page will.
「服務帳戶」 is Google Cloud's zh-TW name for a service account, the thing the user has to find in the GCP console; it is not a CLI Pulse account.
